title: Welcome to DashPlayer
subtitle: Learn English with shows: import a video, get transcription and translation, turn words into study cards.
skipDescription: You can start with the basics like importing videos. Translation and dictionary features can be enabled anytime later in Settings → Features / Service Credentials.

engine.title: Choose where AI features run
engine.description: Subtitle translation and dictionary can run locally or through a cloud API. You can change this anytime in Settings.
engine.localDescription: Free, offline, no sign-up. Download one local model to get subtitle translation and dictionary.
engine.cloudDescription: Connect an OpenAI-compatible API for better quality and advanced features like sentence learning.
engine.cloudNote: Tencent Translate, Youdao Dictionary and others are supported too — configure them later in Settings → Service Credentials.
engine.localModelApplied: Local engine is ready. Subtitle translation and dictionary will use the local model.
engine.cloudModelsLabel: Available models (optional, comma-separated, blank for default)
engine.cloudApplied: Cloud API is configured. Subtitle translation and dictionary will use OpenAI.
engine.appliedNotYet: Nothing applied yet. You can skip or go back.

done.title: You're all set!
done.hint: Import a video to get started. Every engine setting can be adjusted later in Settings.
